subject: English
question_text: Put the following parts of the story in correct order to
stimulus: rewrite the whole story. 1×8=8 (a) The deer's piteous shrick disturbed a hermit sitting in deep meditation near the pool. (b) He said, 'For the crime you have commited you will be turned into a frog'. (c) The hermit's devine meditation being disturbed her rose from his seat and went upto the deer only to find it dead. (d) Inside the forest, the prince was a deer drinking water from a pool and immediately he shot an arrow at it. (e) And since then, the prince had to live as a frog in the pool. (f) He became extremely angry and cursed the prince. (g) One day the young prince went into a forest for a hunting expedition. R Section B : Writing Test (Marks 50)
guide_solution: Reordering sentences (g) + (d) + (a) + (c) + (f) + (b) + (e) Section B : Writing Test
